items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: Joe Howard, sure. Yeah. I'd taken bass horn lessons.

ctx.x: The bass horn player. Joe Howard. Oh, yes. Joe Howard, sure. Yeah. I'd taken bass horn lessons.
Louis Armstrong says he taught him on the boat, too. So I guess he was sort of a teacher, too. He used to help him with his music.
